records.source: I wonder where the flying insects go when it rains? Don't they get hit by the raindrops?
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung saan pumupunta ang mga lumilipad na insekto kapag umuulan. Hindi ba sila tinatamaan ng mga patak ng ulan?

records.source: A day like this is a blessing from mother nature.
records.translation: Isang biyaya mula sa Inang Kalikasan ang araw na tulad nito.

records.source: Good morning... I got this gift for you. Don't worry, I already purified it with sage incense. [428 440 444 338 207]
records.translation: Magandang umaga... May regalo ako para sa iyo. Huwag kang mag-alala, nilinis ko na ito gamit ang insenso ng sage. [428 440 444 338 207]

records.source: I meant to let the parrot go free, but his wing never fully healed. He seems content, though. I give him lots of attention.#$e#He told me that he's happy here.
records.translation: Balak kong palayain ang loro, pero hindi lubusang gumaling ang pakpak niya. Mukha naman siyang kuntento. Marami akong panahong inilalaan sa kanya.#$e#Sinabi niyang masaya siya rito.

records.source: I never told you this... but when you first moved here I had a dream about you. I knew right then that our life-paths would intertwine.$4
records.translation: Hindi ko ito sinabi sa iyo kailanman... pero napanaginipan kita noong una kang lumipat dito. Alam ko noon pa lang na magsasalubong ang mga landas ng buhay natin.$4

records.source: Every moment has a unique and precious beauty... do you notice? It can be easy to forget, sometimes.
records.translation: May natatangi at mahalagang kagandahan ang bawat sandali... napapansin mo ba? Madali itong makalimutan minsan.

records.source: This is my favorite spot for a morning meditation.#$e#I visualize the energy from this crystal garden flowing through my body.
records.translation: Ito ang paborito kong lugar para magnilay-nilay sa umaga.#$e#Inilalarawan ko sa isip ang enerhiya mula sa harding kristal na dumadaloy sa katawan ko.

records.source: I can hear the plants talking to each other... they're so happy after today's rain!
records.translation: Naririnig kong nag-uusap ang mga halaman... napakasaya nila matapos ang ulan ngayon!

records.source: How was your day, @? You look a little soggy.
records.translation: Kumusta ang araw mo, @? Mukhang medyo basang-basa ka.

records.source: My day was very peaceful. How was yours?
records.translation: Napakapayapa ng araw ko. Kumusta naman ang araw mo?

records.source: Want some dessert? It's my special raw, gluten-free version, sweetened only with cactus syrup.[232 234 223 220]$h
records.translation: Gusto mo ng panghimagas? Espesyal kong bersiyon ito na hilaw, walang gluten, at pinatamis lamang ng arnibal ng kaktus.[232 234 223 220]$h

records.source: Does the sound of rain ever put you in a trance?
records.translation: Nailalagay ka ba sa tila kawalan ng ulirat ng tunog ng ulan?

records.source: Another beautiful day on %farm farm... I have faith that something good will happen today!$h
records.translation: Isa na namang magandang araw sa Bukid na %farm... Nananalig akong may magandang mangyayari ngayon!$h

records.source: Here, take this. It's for you. [428 440 444 338 207 395 749]
records.translation: Heto, kunin mo ito. Para sa iyo. [428 440 444 338 207 395 749]

records.source: Hey, someone must've gotten a good night of sleep... you look fresh this morning.$h
records.translation: Uy, mukhang may nakatulog nang mahimbing... napakasigla mo ngayong umaga.$h

records.source: My horoscope for the day isn't too good... but I'm going to make the best of it, as always. Let's get to work!
records.translation: Hindi gaanong maganda ang horoscope ko ngayon... pero susulitin ko pa rin ang araw, gaya ng lagi. Magtrabaho na tayo!

records.source: Ughh... *gurgle*... I ate too many bran muffins for breakfast.$s
records.translation: Ughh... *kumalam*... Naparami ang kain ko ng bran muffin sa almusal.$s

records.source: Is that a new hole I see in your shirt? I can sew that up for you, no problem.
records.translation: Bagong butas ba iyan sa damit mo? Matatahi ko iyan para sa iyo, walang problema.

records.source: Welcome home, @. I hope you had a wonderful day.
records.translation: Maligayang pag-uwi, @. Sana ay naging kahanga-hanga ang araw mo.

records.source: Is it bed time already? My, the day just floated away from me again.$u
records.translation: Oras na ba agad ng pagtulog? Naku, lumipas na naman ang buong araw nang hindi ko namamalayan.$u

records.source: Ah, that aroma! It can only be you.$h#$e#It's a good smell.
records.translation: Ah, ang halimuyak na iyan! Siguradong ikaw iyan.$h#$e#Mabango iyon.

records.source: I swept the whole house, washed the windows, dusted, and cleaned the fridge. It was a very productive day!
records.translation: Winalisan ko ang buong bahay, hinugasan ang mga bintana, pinunasan ang alikabok, at nilinis ang pridyider. Napakabunga ng araw na ito!

records.source: I love getting up early. There's a certain freshness to the air and the wildlife is much more active.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong bumangon nang maaga. May kakaibang kasariwaan sa hangin at mas aktibo ang maiilap na hayop.

records.source: What's on the agenda today, dear?
records.translation: Ano ang plano natin ngayon, mahal?

records.source: Oooh! Ooh! I saw another one!$h#$e#I'm counting squirrels.
records.translation: Oooh! Ooh! May nakita na naman ako!$h#$e#Binibilang ko ang mga ardilya.

records.source: A little sunlight is good for you. Just don't get crispy, okay?
records.translation: Mabuti sa iyo ang kaunting sikat ng araw. Huwag ka lang matusta, ha?

records.source: Good morning! I was wondering when you'd finally roll out of bed!$h#$e#It's okay, @... you deserve a good night of rest.
records.translation: Magandang umaga! Iniisip ko kung kailan ka babangon sa kama!$h#$e#Ayos lang, @... karapat-dapat kang matulog nang mahimbing.

records.source: I hope we can raise %kid1 to be kind and considerate. That's more important than getting A's in school.
records.translation: Sana ay mapalaki natin si %kid1 na mabait at maalalahanin. Mas mahalaga iyon kaysa sa matataas na marka sa paaralan.

records.source: Is one child enough, or should we raise another?#$e#I guess we'll just see where fate leads us.
records.translation: Sapat na ba ang isang anak, o magpalaki pa tayo ng isa?#$e#Siguro ay tingnan na lang natin kung saan tayo dadalhin ng tadhana.

records.source: I lit a pale green candle and shook a sprig of baby-mint over %kid1. That should ward off any dangerous spirits.
records.translation: Nagsindi ako ng mapusyaw na berdeng kandila at iwinagayway ang isang munting sanga ng murang menta sa ibabaw ni %kid1. Dapat nitong itaboy ang anumang mapanganib na espiritu.

records.source: A big house, two kids and a parrot... I have my hands full!
records.translation: Malaking bahay, dalawang anak, at isang loro... Napakarami kong inaasikaso!

records.source: Well, %kid2 certainly has your hair...$u
records.translation: Aba, talagang namana ni %kid2 ang buhok mo...$u

records.source: Oh, I already fed the kids their organic quinoa puffs with goat milk. You just focus on the farm!
records.translation: Ah, napakain ko na ang mga bata ng organikong malutong na quinoa na may gatas ng kambing. Magtuon ka lang sa bukid!

records.source: This is so fun to live together! I always thought I'd be single my whole life.
records.translation: Napakasayang mamuhay nang magkasama! Akala ko ay magiging dalaga ako habambuhay.

records.source: It was our destiny to be together... I believe that with all my heart!
records.translation: Tadhana nating magkasama... Buong puso akong naniniwala rito!

records.source: Thanks for taking me into your home. I love this new life.$4
records.translation: Salamat sa pagtanggap sa akin sa tahanan mo. Gustong-gusto ko ang bago kong buhay.$4

records.source: Our vibrational energies are perfectly in tune. Can't you feel it?
records.translation: Ganap na magkatugma ang mga panginginig ng enerhiya natin. Hindi mo ba nararamdaman?

records.source: I was just admiring my wedding amulet... The shell is beautiful! I can feel the pure blue energy radiating from it.$l
records.translation: Hinahangaan ko lang ang palawit ko sa kasal... Napakaganda ng kabibe! Nararamdaman ko ang dalisay na bughaw na enerhiyang nagmumula rito.$l

records.source: I had another dream about us last night. We had climbed to the top of a crystal tree, looking down on the most lush and beautiful meadow. I keep having this dream.#$e#I don't know what it means, but I feel that it's a good omen.
records.translation: Napanaginipan ko na naman tayo kagabi. Umakyat tayo sa tuktok ng isang punong kristal at tumanaw sa pinakamalunti at pinakamagandang parang. Paulit-ulit kong napapanaginipan ito.#$e#Hindi ko alam ang ibig sabihin, pero pakiramdam ko ay magandang palatandaan ito.

records.source: I hope you'll still like me when I grow old and my hair turns to a dull, faded steel.
records.translation: Sana ay gusto mo pa rin ako kapag tumanda ako at naging mapusyaw na kulay-abong bakal ang buhok ko.

records.source: I feel uninspired today.$s
records.translation: Wala akong inspirasyon ngayon.$s

records.source: I'm going to visit town today, and later on I'm going to help out at the saloon. Have a nice day.
records.translation: Dadalaw ako sa bayan ngayon, at mamaya ay tutulong ako sa Stardrop Saloon. Magandang araw sa iyo.

records.source: My day went well... it's good to get out of the house now and then.
records.translation: Naging maganda ang araw ko... Mabuting lumabas ng bahay paminsan-minsan.

records.source: My friends, the plants, have come back to life. I feel content.
records.translation: Muling nabuhay ang mga kaibigan kong halaman. Panatag ako.

records.source: Happy new year, honey. Let's make this a special one.$4
records.translation: Maligayang bagong taon, mahal. Gawin nating natatangi ang taong ito.$4

records.source: Hmm... I'm thinking maybe a salad of fresh foraged greens for dinner tonight?
records.translation: Hmm... Iniisip kong baka salad ng mga sariwang dahong nakalap ang kainin natin ngayong gabi?

records.source: The energy in our bodies fluctuate just as the seasons do. Understanding your own unique rhythm is the first step to inner harmony.
records.translation: Nagbabago ang enerhiya sa mga katawan natin gaya rin ng mga panahon. Ang pag-unawa sa sarili mong natatanging ritmo ang unang hakbang tungo sa panloob na pagkakaisa.

records.source: May Yoba bless you on this lovely day.$7
records.translation: Pagpalain ka nawa ni Yoba sa magandang araw na ito.$7

records.source: The year's already half-way over. Can you believe it?
records.translation: Kalahati na agad ng taon ang lumipas. Makapaniwala ka ba?

records.source: Our bodies are naturally in tune with the seasons. This light and color of fall compels us to prepare for the barren winter.#$e#To our distant ancestors, this feeling was encompassing and vital. For us, it only barely peeks through the noise of modern life.
records.translation: Likas na nakikiayon ang mga katawan natin sa mga panahon. Hinihikayat tayo ng liwanag at kulay ng taglagas na maghanda para sa tigang na taglamig.#$e#Para sa malalayong ninuno natin, bumabalot sa lahat at mahalaga sa buhay ang damdaming ito. Para sa atin, bahagya lamang itong sumisilip sa ingay ng makabagong buhay.

records.source: On a day like this, I have a craving for cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, and cardamom.
records.translation: Sa araw na tulad nito, natatakam ako sa kanela, nutmeg, clove, at cardamom.

records.source: *sigh*... Why does there have to be war and hatred in the world?$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Bakit kailangang magkaroon ng digmaan at poot sa mundo?$s

records.source: I can't help but think of all the poor, frozen squirrels out there right now.$s
records.translation: Hindi ko mapigilang isipin ang lahat ng kaawa-awang ardilyang giniginaw sa labas ngayon.$s

records.source: I'm feeling excited for a new year of farming, @!$h
records.translation: Nasasabik ako sa bagong taon ng pagsasaka, @!$h

records.source: I drank a super-food smoothie this morning and I feel aaah-mazing!$h
records.translation: Uminom ako ng smoothie na punô ng napakasustansiyang sangkap kaninang umaga at napakaganda ng pakiramdam ko!$h

records.source: Phew! It's hot but it feels great, doesn't it?#$e#Maybe we'll see some wild parrots today.
records.translation: Hay! Mainit pero ang sarap sa pakiramdam, hindi ba?#$e#Baka makakita tayo ng mga mailap na loro ngayon.

records.source: Whoops, my hair is frozen solid again.$s
records.translation: Naku, nanigas na naman sa yelo ang buhok ko.$s

records.source: I'm going to spend some time with the parrot today. It breaks my heart that he'll never fly again.$u
records.translation: Maglalaan ako ng oras kasama ang loro ngayon. Masakit sa loob kong hindi na siya muling makalilipad.$u
